purpose: Representative image dataset for criterion-level scoring tests. Each image is chosen to predictably pass or fail one or more scoring criteria so tests can assert expected outcomes without running the full pipeline.
license: Pexels license — free to use, no attribution required. Not a Capital One asset.

images.scene: Hands holding a latte while milk is poured. Warm light, close crop, one person.
images.notes: Baseline on-brand image. Warm, well-exposed, human presence, clear subject.

images.scene: Bright open office. One person working at a wooden desk among monitors and plants.
images.notes: Cooler palette and corporate setting. Color and tone criteria may flag depending on rubric thresholds.

images.scene: Night city seen through a dense blue neon mesh. No people.
images.notes: Dark, neon-blue palette, no human subject. Tests darkness, off-palette color, no-person framing, and cold tone.

images.scene: Portrait of a woman in dim indoor light with heavy shadows.
images.notes: Primarily tests the underexposure / low luminance failure path for the brightness criterion.

images.scene: Girl standing in direct harsh sunlight with blown-out highlights.
images.notes: Primarily tests the overexposure failure path. Blown highlights also compress contrast.

images.scene: Trees in heavy fog. Flat, hazy, almost no tonal range.
images.notes: Primarily tests the low-contrast failure path. Also fails framing (no identifiable subject) and tone (no people).

images.scene: Office room with a dominant blue wall and cool-toned lighting.
images.notes: Primarily tests the off-palette / cold-dominant-color failure path for the color palette criterion.

images.scene: Artistic portrait of a woman with strong motion blur effect.
images.notes: Primarily tests the blur / low-sharpness failure path for the subject sharpness criterion.

images.scene: Extreme close-up half-face portrait; forehead and chin are cut off by the frame.
images.notes: Primarily tests the over-crop / poor-headroom failure path for the subject framing criterion.
Exercises the min_short_side rejection path in filter_photo (default threshold: 64 px). Should never reach any scoring criterion.
Exercises the max_aspect_ratio rejection path in filter_photo (default limit: 5.0). Represents a web banner or letterbox graphic.
